Subject: Nimbus AWS Marketplace private-offer + entitlement mapping

Hi Sam —

Great talking yesterday. Per our call I wanted to capture the minimal action items so we can move Nimbus to a co-sell + private-offer model on AWS Marketplace without delaying your Q3 launches. High-level asks from our side: 

- Confirm the SKU-level mapping between your existing SaaS SKUs and the Marketplace Sku units (attached: sku_map_v1.csv).
- Provide your preferred procurement contact for Private Offer negotiations (name + email).
- Share the latest SOW and any procurement terms you expect (attached: nimbus_sow_v2.pdf).
- If you have an internal entitlement matrix (entitlements per feature), share that — we need to translate to AWS entitlements or enable the "fallthrough" to standard listing if private-offer fails.

Notes on fallthrough: if AWS private-offer is delayed, we recommend publishing a standard listing with a temporary trial SKU and routing co-sell credits via our partner ops—this avoids losing pipeline momentum.

Tentative timeline we discussed:
- This week: confirm SKU map + procurement contact
- Week of Apr 26: legal review and private-offer template exchange
- Week of May 3: pricing sign-off and DocuSign

Attaching the AWS private-offer template we use for most ISV partners (aws_private_offer_template.docx). I’ll loop in Grace and Vivek from partner ops to own the evidence and entitlement mapping.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this down.

Ben
Ben Carter | Head of Alliances (Marketplace)

Thanks Sam / Ben — looping in legal (Markus) and product GTM (Lauren) to surface the evidence asks. Quick runbook from partner ops perspective: 

1) Evidence bundle (we need by Apr 29): SOC2 type II report OR SOC2 bridge letter, data retention policy, and sample audit logs (redacted).
2) Metering verification: we’ll need a short test plan to validate usage signals for the trial SKU (1-2 pages).
3) Entitlement translation: once we get your entitlement CSV we’ll map to AWS SKU entitlements; if a direct 1:1 mapping is impossible we’ll propose a fallthrough mapping table and a temporary trial SKU.
4) Legal redlines: Markus — please review the SOW comments and the private-offer template. If we can get a single consolidated redline back by May 1 we can stay on the timeline.

Sam — two operational asks for you now: 
- Send the entitlement CSV export or Confluence link (even a screenshot) by EOD Fri Apr 23.
- Confirm whether any customers require telemetry suppression; if yes, provide examples so we can scope a compliance carveout.

I’ll prepare a short evidence checklist and share a Drive link in the next message.

Thanks,
Grace
